description.en:
Operator Iana has demonstrated a remarkable aptitude for repeated contention with the enemy upon the battlefield.
The Field Operations Department has thus passed the following resolution:
This operator shall be appointed a Specialist Operator during field operations. In witness whereof,
This badge is hereby conferred upon the above named, whether this band of soldiers needs such recognition notwithstanding.
description.zh:
干员双月擅长于战场上同敌人反复周旋
根据外勤部门决议
在外勤任务中划分为特种干员，特别颁发此证章
但是像他们这样的人，真的需要这种证明么？

description.en: 'Commence voice recording. Rhodes Island, Team Rainbow, codename: Iana. Internal team comms, confidential. 'Uh, X days since the transfer incident—I'll fill that in once I get back to base—and 41 days since beginning experiments in Sargon. 'While sun was up, retrieved all cameras we deployed on the first day. Currently loading obtained images into terminals. Terminals here can only do wired connections to the server, and the server in my car isn't powerful enough to handle my processing needs, so any specific analysis needs to wait until I get back to base. 'I brought along my eyes and brain too, so while it's loading I've been going through these photos manually since sunup. That way I can at least get some preliminary hypotheses going, and can to some extent inspect and verify the results we've previously observed elsewhere. 'The Columbians—I mean, Terran Columbians—recently launched an experimental device that's likely a high-energy particle beam. Opened a hole in the sky. 'The sky is fake' will probably end up as common sense and popular opinion. 'Meanwhile, our own experiment seems likely to help infer the coherence and uniformity of this false sky. 'Just examining the photos with the naked eye, the stars demonstrate clear discontinuities between different times and regions. Far worse than what the literature describes. Conclusion waiting on main server analysis, but I estimate it won't be too far from my first instinct. 'This implies the sky has no coherence whatsoever, and is essentially more of a regional projection originating from outside. I have a few other conjectures as well. 'That said, I still have confidence in the terrestrial planet hypothesis—ordinary optical surveys support this. While most locals may not be able to give a full justification, universally they have an awareness—they've likely never seen the sea their whole lives, but they know the land beneath them is actually round. 'The people here understand wireless technology, but their signals seem unable to reach this planet's ionosphere. Their alternative is a sort of linked relay: ultra-high bandwidth, energy cost practically negligible. But it appears that because of this, they've never tried to use medium-wave signals for long-range wireless communication. I can't tell just from the literature whether the issue is with the D or F layer—of course, this assumes Terra has atmospheric and sunlight conditions comparable to Earth. I personally think this is extremely likely. 'Their technology, the way it shifts, and the root of its development may seem completely unlike ours, but counterintuitively there are similarities too. '...... 'Actually, I replicated Karl Jansky's experiment here. Nobody seems to have thought of it, so it fell to me to do it for them. Couldn't help myself, sorry. 'These local Terrans don't know where we merry few came from, but their curiosity in the world outside this planetarium is growing as I speak. 'And I want to help them. I want to be one of the explorers. 'I've always wanted to, no matter where. '...... 'Alright, let's see what signals the antenna's picking up... 'Huh? 'This intensity, this... period... 'What is this?'
description.zh:
“语音记录开始。罗德岛，彩虹小队，代号：双月。队内通信，保密。
“呃，传送事故后第——这个等回到主营地再补上——萨尔贡实验开始后第41天。
“我趁着白天回收了第一天时布置的所有相机，正在把拍摄结果导入到终端里面去。不过这里的终端只能做到和主机的有线连接，我车上的主机性能不足以处理我的算法，所以具体的分析工作必须要等待我返回主营地才能进行。
“但我还带了自己的眼睛和脑子，所以在导入进行的同时，我从白天到现在一直在手动翻检这些照片。这样我至少应该能得出一些初步的假设，也应该能在一定程度上检查验证之前在各地观测的结果。
“哥伦比亚人——我是说，泰拉的哥伦比亚人——近期发射了一种可能是高能粒子束的实验装置，在天上开了个洞。‘天是假的’这件事应该能成为一种常识和公论。
“而我们的实验，则有可能帮助推断这层虚假天空的整体性和均匀性情况。
“就我肉眼观察这些照片的结果，星象在不同的时间和区域都呈现出明显的不连续性。程度比文献资料上的描述剧烈得多。结论还需要等主机分析的结果，但我估计不会和我的第一感觉有太大偏差。
“这意味着天空的整体性可能并不存在，其本质可能是一种分区块进行的投影，源头在外层。我还有其他几个猜测。
“不过，我依然对类地行星的假说有信心——一般光学观测的结果支持这一点。虽然他们大多说不出完整的理由，但本地人也普遍具备这个认识，他们可能一生没见过海，却知道脚下的大地其实是圆的而不是平的。
“这里的人懂得无线电技术，但他们的信号似乎无法到达这个星球的电离层。他们的替代方案是一种中继链路，带宽很高，能耗几乎可以忽略不计。但也因此，他们似乎从未尝试过使用中波信号进行远程无线通信，因此无法从文献资料上得出问题究竟是出在D层还是F层——当然，这些的前提是泰拉行星拥有和地球一致的大气和日照条件。我个人认为这个可能性很高。
“他们的技术、他们技术转移的方法和技术发展的根源和我们似乎完全不同，但其实又有相同之处。
“……
“其实，我在这里复制了卡尔·央斯基的实验。这里似乎没人想到，所以我替他们做了，没忍住，对不起。
“这些泰拉本地人，他们虽然不知道我们这些人来自哪里，但对星空外面的世界的好奇心正变得越来越大。
“而我想要帮助他们，我想要成为探索者的一员。
“无论在哪里，我一直都想。
“……
“好吧，让我们来看看天线接收到了什么信号……
“嗯？
“这个强度，这个……周期……
“……这是什么？”
